source.provenance_note: The delivered files are internally hash-consistent. Preserve these discrepancies; do not rewrite the evidence.

runtime_parity.warning: The formal evaluator uses simulator contact/magnet and scripted return behavior, while deployment uses encoder-based jaw contact, preventive swept-path FloorGuard, and the v23 staged controller. Zero simulated penetration does not prove deployment guard parity; do not lower the 8 mm guard.
